whatIsIt.eli5: A volume knob for each layer of notes: it looks at the whole picture and turns useful layers up and others down.
whatIsIt.simple: Averages each channel over the whole map, passes the result through two tiny 1×1 Convs, and uses the output (0–1) to scale each channel.
whatIsIt.engineer: GAP → Conv1×1(c → max(c/r, 8)) → ReLU → Conv1×1 → σ → channel-wise scaling.

whyExists.eli5: Not every kind of note matters equally for every picture.
whyExists.simple: Lets the network emphasise channels that matter for the current image (for example 'green, thin leaf' patterns for weeds).
whyExists.engineer: Channel recalibration using global context (Hu et al., 2018).

eli5: Decide how important each layer is.
Turn each layer up or down.
simple: Global average pool: one number per channel.
1×1 Conv shrinks by r, ReLU, 1×1 Conv back, sigmoid.
Multiply each channel by its weight.

costNote.simple: Adds about 2·c²/r parameters and almost no compute. Changes the YAML (custom block), so it needs the parse_model edit; weights for this block start from scratch.
costNote.engineer: ~2c²/r params; latency mainly from the extra memory pass.

typicalPositions.eli5: After a block, often in the mixing part.
typicalPositions.simple: Commonly after the last block of a backbone stage or after neck blocks that feed the head.
